title: Countries and territories by which side of the road they drive on

source.name: Left- and right-hand traffic
source.publisher: worldstandards.eu / worldpopulationreview.com compilation of national traffic laws

notes: Approximately 76 countries and territories drive on the left (mostly former British territories), versus roughly 163 that drive on the right. Figures approximate as widely compiled and reported; totals vary slightly by source depending on how small territories are counted.
